warnings: Mapocho assets are assigned only to generic mapocho-3521; no new Mapocho asset is assigned to Edificio A.
Rosas original plan raster images are only 246-364 px wide; full-page typography is rendered at 2400 px but this does not add architectural detail. Model previews retain native resolution.
Guillermo Mann page 13 is labeled 2 dormitorios + 1 baño (KC), but the drawing shows two bathrooms. Preserve original page and require a data-level conflict note.
Plaza de Lourdes facade/courtyard source is repeated at different sizes in PDF; only the higher-quality instance of each scene is selected.
Guillermo Mann pool scene is repeated as a portrait crop; only higher-resolution landscape version is selected.

Some Euro brochures themselves reuse common-space illustrations across projects (e.g. Don Pepe/Independencia terrace; Rosas/Guillermo kids room). Each included asset is sourced from that project own brochure; no extra cross-project attribution was inferred.
